_comment: Golden decision labels. Each names a position (tests/eval/decisions/positions.py), the expected play, the rule, the replay source, and the evidence that sets its confidence (tools/decision_eval.py: rules_forced = 1.0; else the minimum of rollout p_better and the reviewers' non-refuted share; with neither, unverified_confidence). tests/test_golden_decisions.py requires every label at or above gate_confidence to pass.

labels.rule: A spell that returns a creature card from its caster's graveyard delivers it this turn; with Archon of Cruelty in the graveyard, Persist is not deferred (unit RN).
labels.source: Grixis Reanimator vs Azorius Blink s53000, turn 7 (game turn): Persist +48.9 passed over for Emperor of Bones +1.8

labels.rule: A storm closer below lethal holds while chain fuel castable this turn remains, graveyard flashback included (unit GYF).
labels.source: Ruby Storm goldfish s70004 turn 8: Grapeshot at storm 9, then four flashback casts after it

labels.rule: A graveyard flashback grant lasts this turn only; with no granted spell affordable after it resolves it does nothing and spends the card (CR 702.34a; unit PFG).
labels.source: Ruby Storm goldfish s70000 turns 4, 5 and 7

labels.rule: A blink returns a new, summoning-sick object (CR 400.7): before combat it costs the attack, after combat the same blink does the same for no attack (unit BLK).
labels.source: Goryo's Vengeance goldfish s70000 turn 4 (Ephemerate at -4.09 cast); Jeskai Blink vs Broodscale s50000

labels.rule: After combat the blink forfeits nothing and keeps the dashed creature, which would otherwise return to hand at end of turn (unit BLK).
A hand attack is aimed at its caster only when binning has value; with no reanimation target in hand, hitting its own hand only discards its own card (unit HAS).
labels.source: Grixis Reanimator goldfish s70001 turn 4: Thoughtseize discarded Cling to Dust from its own hand

labels.rule: The legend rule keeps one of several same-named legendary permanents; a second copy of a controlled legend returns nothing that stays (CR 704.5j; unit LGR).

expect.includes: Hanweir Battlements // Hanweir, the Writhing Township

labels.rule: A land whose ability grants haste is worth the attack it converts this turn when it will be untapped (unit HL).
labels.source: Amulet Titan goldfish s70002: Titan fetched bounce lands for three turns while the haste land stayed in the library

labels.rule: A sideboard counterspell comes in when most of the opponent's nonland spells are ones it answers for no more than their mana value; a 3-mana Dispute does not answer red 1-2 mana spells (unit LSB).
labels.source: Ruby Storm vs Domain Zoo, game 2 collapse (Storm diagnostic)
